item.title: FTSE 100 held back by AstraZeneca as oil drops
item.summary: The FTSE 100 started the week higher after Donald Trump said he planned to restart talks with Iran. The index rose in very early trade before fading back to trade flat at the time of the writing.“Global equities have kicked off the week on the front foot, picking up right where Friday’s session left off,” said Daniela Hathorn, […] The post FTSE 100 held back by AstraZeneca as oil drops appeared first on UK Investor Magazine .
